lines.text: Shopify lets an AI hacker attack its real systems, so attackers do not find the holes first.
AI makes finding bugs cheap. Shopify's bug bounty reports rose almost three hundred percent since 2024.
lines.title: Why now

lines.text: An idea goes to Discovery, which finds leads. A sandbox agent then tries to exploit them and reports back.
lines.title: One engagement

lines.text: The attacker runs locked down: no special rights, short-lived logins, and only a few allowed websites.
lines.title: Safety locks

lines.text: A second AI, from a different model, reads everything the attacker does. If it breaks the rules, it is killed.
lines.title: Two-person rule

lines.text: So far, tens of thousands of attempts found dozens of important issues, with no outage.
If the judge goes quiet, the run simply stops.
lines.title: Takeaways
